question.text: What is eye diagram, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

exchange.sent: What is eye diagram, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

answer.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
In the supplied passages, an eye diagram is not formally defined; it is treated as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item and as an “eye opening” measurement characterized by eye height and eye width after equalization in PCIe Gen3/Gen4/Gen5 context [1][5][16].
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it are material/stackup selection, signal-integrity flow choices, PCIe redriver output eye-opening evaluation, PCB layout/material choices that can degrade the receiver differential eye diagram, and whether a measurement setup needs extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram capability [5][19][20][58][98][100].
### Supported details
- High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists “IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram” together with TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator, so eye diagram is one of the measurements/analysis items considered in that flow [1][2][16].  
- R&S PCB test solutions for PCB Fabricator and System House list Eye diagram under Material/Stackup selection together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling, so understanding eye diagram affects material/stackup selection decisions in that flow [19][20][76].  
- PCIe eye-opening decisions depend on eye diagram understanding because the cited PCIe Gen3/Gen4/Gen5 table gives extrapolated eye height after EQ and minimum eye width after EQ, and states that PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to the listed values [5].  
- The listed PCIe eye-opening values are Gen3: 25 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 37.5 ps eye width, Gen4: 15 ± 1.5 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 18.75 ± 0.55 ps eye width, and Gen5: 15 ± 1.5 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 9.375 ± 0.5 ps eye width [5].  
- PCB layout/material decisions depend on eye diagram understanding because fiberglass weave and epoxy permittivity differences can create intra-pair skew, and that skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver [58].  
- Product/option-level selection cannot be finalized from these passages because the R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [78].  
- The raw product/spec text does list “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” so a measurement decision may involve whether this capability is needed, but the passages do not identify a product name or option code for it [98][100].

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCB material 與 insertion loss
[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出：

- 溫度與濕度升高時，[[insertion loss]] 會增加。
- Data rate 越高，loss 越高。
- [[Insertion loss]] 與 board material 有關。
- Ultra Low Loss material 在不同 data rate 下的 loss 低於 standard loss material。
- Megtron 6 等 ultra low-loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 預期比 nominal temperature 高最多 8%。
- FR4 等 higher loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 比 nominal temperature 高 11%。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › 未決事項
- [[PCI Express Base Specification Revision 5.0]] 的正式版本、章節與發布組織頁尚未建立。
- [[CXL 2.0]] 與 [[TI DS320PR1601]] data sheet 需另以正式 datasheet 補證。
- `Roger` 是否應修正為 Rogers 或特定 laminate product family 仍需回查原文。
- Megtron 6、GETEK、Nelco 4000-6、FR4、Tetra Functional FR4 的材料規格與 datasheet 未納入。
- 來源未標示 TI 建議對不同 PCB stack-up、trace geometry 與 connector 類型的適用範圍。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › 文件脈絡
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）是 [[Texas Instruments]] application note《High-Speed PCB Layout for PCIe Gen 5》，文件編號 SNLA426，作者 [[Vicente Flores Prado]]。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）目標是協助熟悉 [[PCB manufacturing]]、[[PCB layout]] 與 design 的人員，在設計 high-speed [[PCI Express]] 平台時理解 PCB layout best practices 與 layout options。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] 資料傳輸速率為 32 GT/s；Gen5 x16 lane 設計需要以最佳化 [[crosstalk]]、[[return loss]]、[[insertion loss]] 為核心。

answer.text:
### Short answer
In the supplied passages, an eye diagram is not formally defined; it is treated as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item and as an “eye opening” measurement characterized by eye height and eye width after equalization in PCIe Gen3/Gen4/Gen5 context [1][5][16].
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it are material/stackup selection, signal-integrity flow choices, PCIe redriver output eye-opening evaluation, PCB layout/material choices that can degrade the receiver differential eye diagram, and whether a measurement setup needs extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram capability [5][19][20][58][98][100].
### Supported details
- High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists “IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram” together with TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator, so eye diagram is one of the measurements/analysis items considered in that flow [1][2][16].  
- R&S PCB test solutions for PCB Fabricator and System House list Eye diagram under Material/Stackup selection together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling, so understanding eye diagram affects material/stackup selection decisions in that flow [19][20][76].  
- PCIe eye-opening decisions depend on eye diagram understanding because the cited PCIe Gen3/Gen4/Gen5 table gives extrapolated eye height after EQ and minimum eye width after EQ, and states that PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to the listed values [5].  
- The listed PCIe eye-opening values are Gen3: 25 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 37.5 ps eye width, Gen4: 15 ± 1.5 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 18.75 ± 0.55 ps eye width, and Gen5: 15 ± 1.5 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 9.375 ± 0.5 ps eye width [5].  
- PCB layout/material decisions depend on eye diagram understanding because fiberglass weave and epoxy permittivity differences can create intra-pair skew, and that skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver [58].  
- Product/option-level selection cannot be finalized from these passages because the R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [78].  
- The raw product/spec text does list “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” so a measurement decision may involve whether this capability is needed, but the passages do not identify a product name or option code for it [98][100].

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 中游 — 模組整合與生產製造
- 晶片封測製造。
- 高速連接線材與接頭組裝。
- 系統級整合：製造通信設備、服務器用的光傳輸設備、交換機、路由器等中間件設備。
- 電腦與消費性電子裝置整合 [[HDMI]]、[[USB]]、[[PCIe]] 介面等，含各類轉換器、擴充塢、模組等。
- 高速 PCB 設計：涉及阻抗控制、差分對布局、地平面配置等，確保訊號品質。

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 下游 — 終端應用與市場部署
- 通訊設備製造商：核心網、5G 基站、光傳輸設備、交換機、路由器等。
- 服務器與資料中心：協助 AI、高效能計算環境部署，需求高速內部連與介面連接。
- 網通基礎建設與雲端應用：包含物聯網、雲計算與邊緣運算等場域皆需高速數據傳輸與處理能力。
- 消費電子與車用領域：筆電 / 手機等需 [[HDMI]]、[[DisplayPort]]、[[USB]] 介面，汽車上的 [[ADAS]] 與 [[V2X]] 通訊亦需高速訊號傳輸。
- 工業與智慧製造：工業自動化系統、高速資料擷取與辨識也仰賴高速訊號鏈路。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCB material 與 insertion loss
[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出：

- 溫度與濕度升高時，[[insertion loss]] 會增加。
- Data rate 越高，loss 越高。
- [[Insertion loss]] 與 board material 有關。
- Ultra Low Loss material 在不同 data rate 下的 loss 低於 standard loss material。
- Megtron 6 等 ultra low-loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 預期比 nominal temperature 高最多 8%。
- FR4 等 higher loss material 在高溫下的 insertion loss 比 nominal temperature 高 11%。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › 未決事項
- [[PCI Express Base Specification Revision 5.0]] 的正式版本、章節與發布組織頁尚未建立。
- [[CXL 2.0]] 與 [[TI DS320PR1601]] data sheet 需另以正式 datasheet 補證。
- `Roger` 是否應修正為 Rogers 或特定 laminate product family 仍需回查原文。
- Megtron 6、GETEK、Nelco 4000-6、FR4、Tetra Functional FR4 的材料規格與 datasheet 未納入。
- 來源未標示 TI 建議對不同 PCB stack-up、trace geometry 與 connector 類型的適用範圍。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › 文件脈絡
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）是 [[Texas Instruments]] application note《High-Speed PCB Layout for PCIe Gen 5》，文件編號 SNLA426，作者 [[Vicente Flores Prado]]。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）目標是協助熟悉 [[PCB manufacturing]]、[[PCB layout]] 與 design 的人員，在設計 high-speed [[PCI Express]] 平台時理解 PCB layout best practices 與 layout options。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] 資料傳輸速率為 32 GT/s；Gen5 x16 lane 設計需要以最佳化 [[crosstalk]]、[[return loss]]、[[insertion loss]] 為核心。

answer.text:
### Short answer
In the supplied passages, an eye diagram is not formally defined; it is treated as a high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item and as an “eye opening” measurement characterized by eye height and eye width after equalization in PCIe Gen3/Gen4/Gen5 context [1][5][16].
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it are material/stackup selection, signal-integrity flow choices, PCIe redriver output eye-opening evaluation, PCB layout/material choices that can degrade the receiver differential eye diagram, and whether a measurement setup needs extended time-domain analysis including eye diagram capability [5][19][20][58][98][100].
### Supported details
- High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists “IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram” together with TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator, so eye diagram is one of the measurements/analysis items considered in that flow [1][2][16].  
- R&S PCB test solutions for PCB Fabricator and System House list Eye diagram under Material/Stackup selection together with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, and TL modeling, so understanding eye diagram affects material/stackup selection decisions in that flow [19][20][76].  
- PCIe eye-opening decisions depend on eye diagram understanding because the cited PCIe Gen3/Gen4/Gen5 table gives extrapolated eye height after EQ and minimum eye width after EQ, and states that PCIe redriver output eye opening must be greater than or equal to the listed values [5].  
- The listed PCIe eye-opening values are Gen3: 25 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 37.5 ps eye width, Gen4: 15 ± 1.5 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 18.75 ± 0.55 ps eye width, and Gen5: 15 ± 1.5 mV eye height and 0.3 UI / 9.375 ± 0.5 ps eye width [5].  
- PCB layout/material decisions depend on eye diagram understanding because fiberglass weave and epoxy permittivity differences can create intra-pair skew, and that skew can degrade the differential eye diagram seen by the receiver [58].  
- Product/option-level selection cannot be finalized from these passages because the R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [78].  
- The raw product/spec text does list “Extended time domain analysis (including eye diagram),” so a measurement decision may involve whether this capability is needed, but the passages do not identify a product name or option code for it [98][100].

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。
